work_title: In This Corner of the World (Film)

places.name: Kure
places.connection: Kure is the primary setting of the film, depicting Suzu's life in the naval port city during World War II.

places.name: Hiroshima
places.connection: Hiroshima is depicted in the film as a nearby city, significant to the storyline and historical context.

places.name: Shukkeien Garden
places.connection: The garden is featured in the film as part of Suzu's visit to Hiroshima, showcasing its historical beauty.

places.name: Yamato Museum
places.connection: The museum, dedicated to the battleship Yamato, reflects Kure's naval history, which is central to the film's setting.
